name: inception
description: Make AI-assisted fiction, presentations, documents, and organic social posts less generic, formulaic, repetitive, over-explained, or unsupported without losing the author's intent.

interface.shortDescription: Make AI-assisted writing less generic without losing intent
interface.longDescription: Find generic, formulaic, repetitive, over-explained, or unsupported content decisions in fiction, presentations, documents, and organic social posts. Preserve the author's intent and wait for human decisions before material revision.
